fusions.name: Final Signature
fusions.desc: A finishing chop on an enemy at or below 25% health that deals 24 damage and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Margin Notes
fusions.desc: A thin sweep that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Stropped on Vellum
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 40% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Kept Tally
fusions.desc: Every kill is written down as a stack on you, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (20% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
